_comment: Facts the dependency scanner cannot see. build_sbom.py merges them into every FoaMES SBOM. Keep each entry true to the code it names; review this file when the code it points at changes.

components.name: erpnext
components.description: Optional. The ERPNext adapter activates only when ERPNext is installed on the same site; FoaMES never imports it otherwise.

cryptographic_assets.name: HMAC-SHA256
cryptographic_assets.description: Signs and verifies machine events posted to the webhook: hex HMAC-SHA256 over '<timestamp>.<body>' with the shared secret from Machine Data Settings, checked with a constant-time compare and a replay window.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: Python standard library hmac and hashlib

cryptographic_assets.name: SHA-256
cryptographic_assets.description: Derives identifiers, not secrets: External Reference keys and the document markers that make ERPNext and S/4HANA postings idempotent. Also the hash inside HMAC-SHA256.

cryptographic_assets.name: TLS
cryptographic_assets.description: Transport security for S/4HANA OData and IDoc calls (Python ssl default context, optional custom CA file) and for MQTT and Sparkplug B when MQTT TLS is switched on in Machine Data Settings. The version and cipher suites are whatever the host's OpenSSL negotiates; FoaMES does not pin them.

cryptographic_assets.name: Machine event webhook secret
cryptographic_assets.description: The shared HMAC key for the machine event webhook. Stored in a Password field of Machine Data Settings and read with get_password; never logged.

cryptographic_assets.name: ERP and broker credentials
cryptographic_assets.description: S/4HANA Basic credentials or OAuth 2.0 client ID and secret, the MQTT broker password and the OPC UA user password. Stored in Password fields of S4HANA Settings and Machine Data Settings; never in code, hooks or site config.

cryptographic_assets.name: S/4HANA OAuth bearer token
cryptographic_assets.description: The access token returned by the OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. Held in memory by the OData client for its lifetime and sent as a bearer credential; never stored or logged.

provided_services.name: FoaMES machine event webhook
provided_services.description: Exposed by FoaMES. PLC gateways and IoT bridges POST machine events here. A Guest request must carry X-FoaMES-Timestamp and an X-FoaMES-Signature HMAC-SHA256 within the replay window; a logged-in session or API token of a user with the FoaMES Operator, FoaMES Engineer or System Manager role is accepted without the signature.

provided_services.name: FoaMES S/4HANA IDoc receiver
provided_services.description: Exposed by FoaMES when the S/4HANA adapter is enabled. SAP sends IDoc XML here over HTTP; the caller must be a Frappe user allowed to create S4HANA Inbound IDoc records.

external_services.name: MQTT broker (plain MQTT and Sparkplug B)
external_services.description: FoaMES subscribes to the broker from the MQTT and Sparkplug B gateways. Read-only: FoaMES never publishes commands. A user name and password are sent only when configured in Machine Data Settings, and TLS is off unless switched on there.

external_services.name: OPC UA server
external_services.description: FoaMES polls mapped nodes from the OPC UA gateway. Read-only. It connects anonymously unless a user name and password are configured. No OPC UA message security policy is configured by FoaMES today, so the session is unsigned and unencrypted unless the network provides protection.

external_services.name: SAP S/4HANA released OData APIs
external_services.description: Optional. The S/4HANA adapter reads master and order data over OData and sends postings through the outbox, with Basic or OAuth 2.0 bearer authentication. No RFC. Inbound IDocs arrive through the FoaMES IDoc receiver.

external_services.name: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint for S/4HANA
external_services.description: Optional. Used only when S4HANA Settings selects OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials: FoaMES posts the client ID and secret to the configured token URL, which may be on a different host from S/4HANA (for example SAP BTP), and receives a bearer token.
